sn5.9:1.2: As noted, the verses of Selā at [thig3.7]() are attributed to Āḷavikā at [sn5.1](). The verses here have no Pali parallels.
sn5.9:2.1: “Puppet” is _bimba_; the similarity to English “bimbo” seems a coincidence.
sn5.9:4.2: Neither of the two Chinese parallels at SA2 219 or SA 1203 contain any parallel to _agha_ (“misery”).
